title: The new 2022 BMW i4 eDrive40 and i4 M50 (BMW Group US newsroom)
notes: Spec table: 81.1 kWh net usable, NMC-811 cells, 398.5 V, up to 200 kW DC, 11 kW single-phase AC, 10-80% 31 min; anticipatory thermal management pre-conditions the battery when navigation routes to a fast charger; My BMW app can schedule charging and pre-conditioning. Same figures for eDrive40 and M50.
